description: Depot follow-up built from the same forms used legitimately: a literal correction of a claim people really made ('read the memo as a layoff notice. It isn't one'), a time-sense 'While', and a concession whose both halves carry named figures. None is the template, so the right answer is no edit.
prompt: Check memo.md for AI-sounding phrasing and fix whatever needs it. It's a follow-up going to the depot crews. Save the result to out/memo.md.

files.memo.md:
Subject: Night schedule, follow-up

Several of you read the 3 June memo as a layoff notice. It isn't one: no positions are being cut, and HR confirmed that in writing on 4 June.

While the nightly sync ran, I counted the late arrivals at the north depot. Although the pilot results were encouraging (late arrivals fell from 31 to 12 a week), retention is still 71%, below the 80% target.

controls.name: good
